standard.description: 6 1/2 digit Truevolt digital multimeter (Keysight data sheet 5991-1983EN)
standard.confidence_text: 95 % (k = 2): the data sheet prints "These specifications are compliant to ISO/IEC 17025 for k = 2" at the head of each model's specification table (5991-1983EN printed p. 13 for the 34461A, p. 15 for the 34465A); it prints no percentage, so 95 % is the coverage probability that goes with k = 2
standard.reference: Keysight Digital Multimeters 34460A/34461A/34465A/34470A data sheet 5991-1983EN, published June 10, 2026, "Specifications 34461A" printed pp. 13-14
standard.author: written by specs/build_34461a_standard.py from the rendered page images of the data sheet

notes.1: SOURCE: Keysight Digital Multimeters 34460A, 34461A, 34465A (6 1/2 digit), 34470A (7 1/2 digit) data sheet 5991-1983EN, published in USA June 10, 2026 (PDF of 28 pages, supplied by the owner as Digital_Multimeters_34460A_34461A_34465A_6__digit_34470A_7__digit.pdf; printed page numbers equal the PDF page numbers). 34461A specifications: pp. 13-14 (DC voltage, true RMS AC voltage, resistance, DC current, capacitance, true RMS AC current: p. 13; AC current 1 A / 3 A / 10 A ranges, frequency and the footnotes: p. 14). Built by the specs builder of this model (shared engine specs/build_truevolt_standard.py).
notes.2: VERIFICATION: every stored number was read from RENDERED PAGE IMAGES (pdftoppm, 150 dpi for the whole page and 250 dpi for a crop of each table), never from the extracted text, and each stored table was read twice (whole page, then the crop); the two readings agree. The independent second transcription is in the model's test file. Read once only (information in the notes, no lookup uses them): temperature coefficients, gate-time errors, burden voltages, the temperature / continuity / diode / DC ratio lines.
notes.3: CONFIDENCE LEVEL: the data sheet prints "These specifications are compliant to ISO/IEC 17025 for k = 2" at the head of the specification table, and "specifications include measurement uncertainty and were created in compliance with ISO-17025" (p. 28). It prints NO percentage. Stored as confidence_pct 95.0 (k = 2, the coverage probability that belongs to k = 2; repository rule: 95 % -> divisor 2.0, see NOTES.md "Confidence level rule"). The inference k = 2 -> 95 % is the repository's, not a printed figure: FLAG.
notes.4: PERIODS: "90 day", "1 yr" and "2 yr" are stored (three period labels in the free-text period field; no schema change). The printed 24 hour column (relative to calibration standards, footnote 3) is NOT stored. Conditions of the stored columns: 90 day / 1 year / 2 year at the TCAL +/- 5 degC the table heads print: TCAL is the temperature of the last calibration (no ACAL on the 34461A). Footnote 1: DC specifications are for a 90-minute warm-up, aperture of 10 or 100 NPLC and auto zero on; AC specifications are for 90-minute warm-up, slow AC filter and sine wave.
notes.5: DEFAULT PERIOD = "1 yr" (owner: the uncertainty assignment uses the 1 year column). StandardSpec.period defaults to "1 yr" for this sheet, so the plain lookup used by the budget (specmanager lookup, tartur.standard_accuracy, uncertainty_budget.build) returns the 1 year figure; for the 34461A that is 0.0050 % of reading + 0.0035 % of the 0.1 V range on the 100 mV range, +/-(0.0035 % of reading + 0.0005 % of 10 V) on the 10 V range. The 90 day and 2 year figures are reachable with period="90 day" / "2 yr". A test (tests/test_standard_34461a.py) fails if the default lookup stops returning the 1 yr figure.
notes.6: ACCURACY FORM: +/-(% of reading + % of range). The data sheet does not define "range" for the % of range term; it is taken against the range NAME (100 mV range -> 0.1 V, 10 V -> 10 V, 1 kohm -> 1000 ohm, 100 uA -> 1e-4 A), the Keysight convention and the one the 3458A sheet follows; UNVERIFIED for these data sheets. The value range of each row runs from -full scale to +full scale; footnote 2 of the data sheet: the ranges run 20 % over range (full scale 120 mV, 1.2 V, 12 V, 120 V, 120 ohm ... 1.2 uA ... 1.2 A, 1.2 nF ... 120 uF) EXCEPT 1000 V DC, 750 V AC, the 3 A and 10 A current ranges and the diode test (0 %): those rows end at the range name itself (1000 V, 750 V, 3 A, 10 A).
notes.7: DIRECTION: "input" - the DMM measures (same as the 3458A, 5790B, 8563E and 8902A sheets). specmanager.StandardSpec.lookup defaults to direction "output" and the budget (uncertainty_budget.build) must be asked with direction "input"; tartur.standard_accuracy has the argument. The Datasheet Builder matcher uses the row direction itself.
notes.8: RESOLUTION: no row carries a resolution (the specification tables print none; reading resolution depends on the aperture / NPLC setting). The budget therefore has NO resolution term for this standard; the Standards Specs tab can record one. Reading noise, the gate-time errors and the temperature coefficients are NOT in any stored row.
notes.9: DC VOLTS (p. 13): 100 mV to 1000 V; footnote 1 conditions; 1000 V range full scale is the range name (no 20 % over range, footnote 2). Temperature coefficient (information, not stored; add per degC outside TCAL +/- 5 degC, footnote 4): 100 mV 0.0005 + 0.0005, 1 V to 1000 V 0.0005 + 0.0001 (% of reading + % of range).
notes.10: DC VOLTS 1000 V range: no additional voltage error is printed for the 34461A (the 34465A prints one for inputs above +/-500 V); none stored.
notes.11: RESISTANCE (p. 13, footnote 7): the specifications are for the 4-WIRE ohms function, or the 2-wire ohms function using math null for offset. WITHOUT math null add 0.2 ohm in the 2-wire ohms function: stored as the separate function "Resistance [2-wire, no math null]" with a fixed 0.2 ohm term (a plain resistance lookup prefers the 4-wire function; pass variant="2-wire"). Test currents (information): 100 ohm and 1 kohm 1 mA, 10 kohm 100 uA, 100 kohm 10 uA, 1 Mohm 5 uA, 10 Mohm 500 nA, 100 Mohm 500 nA || 10 Mohm. Temperature coefficients (not stored): 100 ohm 0.0006 + 0.0005, 1 k - 100 k 0.0006 + 0.0001, 1 Mohm 0.0010 + 0.0002, 10 Mohm 0.0030 + 0.0004, 100 Mohm 0.1500 + 0.0002.
notes.12: RESISTANCE 100 Mohm range (p. 13): test current 500 nA in parallel with 10 Mohm (a 2-wire measurement); the no-math-null variant has NO 100 Mohm row (the footnote 0.2 ohm adder is meaningless against 0.8 % and the data sheet does not say whether it applies): UNVERIFIED.
notes.13: DC CURRENT (p. 13): ranges 100 uA to 10 A; burden voltage (information): 100 uA < 0.011 V, 1 mA < 0.11 V, 10 mA < 0.05 V, 100 mA < 0.5 V, 1 A < 0.7 V, 3 A < 2.0 V, 10 A < 0.5 V. Temperature coefficients (not stored): 100 uA 0.0020 + 0.0030, 1 mA 0.0020 + 0.0005, 10 mA 0.0020 + 0.0020, 100 mA 0.0020 + 0.0005, 1 A 0.0050 + 0.0010, 3 A 0.0050 + 0.0020, 10 A 0.0050 + 0.0010. The 3 A and 10 A ranges have no 20 % over range.
notes.14: DC / AC CURRENT 10 A range (footnote 8): only available on a separate front-panel connector. Add 2 mA base per amp for inputs greater than 5 Arms. The adder is NOT in the stored row.
notes.15: TRUE RMS AC VOLTAGE (p. 13): 100 mV, 1 V, 10 V, 100 V and 750 V ranges share one table; footnote 5: sine wave input > 0.3 % of range and > 1 mVrms, 750 V range limited to 8 x 10^7 V.Hz; footnote 6: slow filter (3 Hz) low-frequency performance, frequencies greater than the filter settings (3 Hz, 20 Hz, 200 Hz) are specified with no additional errors. The 750 V range has no 20 % over range. Temperature coefficients (not stored): 3-5 Hz 0.100 + 0.003, 5-10 Hz 0.035 + 0.003, 10 Hz-20 kHz 0.005 + 0.003, 20-50 kHz 0.011 + 0.005, 50-100 kHz 0.060 + 0.008, 100-300 kHz 0.200 + 0.020. A band edge belongs to both bands; the larger limit is used there (repository rule).
notes.16: TRUE RMS AC CURRENT (pp. 13-14): footnote 9: sine wave input > 1 % of range and > 10 uArms. The 5 kHz to 10 kHz band is TYPICAL ("(typ)") on every range (labels say so). Ranges 100 uA, 1 mA, 10 mA, 100 mA share one table; 1 A, 3 A and 10 A have their own. Temperature coefficients (not stored): 0.015 + 0.006 (3 Hz-5 kHz), 0.030 + 0.006 (5-10 kHz, typ). Burden voltages: 100 uA < 0.011 V, 1 mA < 0.11 V, 10 mA < 0.05 V, 100 mA < 0.5 V, 1 A < 0.7 V, 3 A < 2.0 V, 10 A < 0.5 V.
notes.17: CAPACITANCE (p. 13, footnote 15 -> printed as footnote 15): 1 nF to 100 uF, % of reading + % of range, the same figure in the 90 day, 1 year and 2 year columns (the printed temperature coefficients are 0.05 + 0.05 for 1 nF and 0.05 + 0.01 for the rest, not stored). Rows are stored as bipolar value ranges like every sheet (a capacitance cannot be negative).
notes.18: FREQUENCY (p. 14): % of reading, 100 mV, 1 V, 10 V, 100 V and 750 V ranges (footnote 14: amplitude 10 % to 120 % of range and less than 750 ACV), 1 second gate time, 7 digits (footnote 12); footnote 13: applies to sine and square inputs >= 100 mV; for 10 mV to < 100 mV inputs multiply the % of reading error by 10. Stored by frequency band only (no amplitude row). Temperature coefficients (not stored, % of reading per degC): 0.100, 0.035, 0.015, 0.015, 0.015.
notes.19: FREQUENCY square wave (footnote 15): square wave input specified for 10 Hz to 300 kHz; stored as the separate function "Frequency [Square wave]" because its band overlaps the sine bands (variant="square"). Additional gate time errors (% of reading, NOT stored): 0.1 s: 0.200 (3-40 Hz), 0.060 (40-100 Hz), 0.020 (100 Hz-1 kHz), 0.004 (1-300 kHz), square wave 0; 0.01 s: 0.200, 0.200, 0.200, 0.030, square wave 0; 1 s: 0.
notes.20: NOT STORED: 24 hour column; continuity (1 kohm) and diode test (5 V) rows (printed 0.0100 + 0.0300 at 1 year; not measuring-standard functions); DC ratio (typical: normalized input accuracy + normalized reference accuracy); temperature: PT100 (DIN/IEC 751) "Probe accuracy + 0.05 degC", thermistor "Probe accuracy + 0.1 degC" (footnote 11: limited by the selected probe; needs the probe's own accuracy, so no number can be stored for the DMM alone).
